mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auto_transfer ( withdrawal_account_id, deposit_account_id, money_box_id, deposit_institution_name, masked_deposit_account, transfer_amount, transfer_day, start_date, end_date, auto_transfer_status ) VALUES ( #{withdrawalAccountId}, #{depositAccountId}, #{moneyBoxId}, #{depositInstitutionName}, #{maskedDepositAccount}, #{transferAmount}, #{transferDay}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{autoTransferStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT auto_transfer_id, withdrawal_account_id, deposit_account_id, money_box_id, deposit_institution_name, masked_deposit_account, transfer_amount, transfer_day, start_date, end_date, auto_transfer_status, created_at, updated_at FROM auto_transfer WHERE ( ( #{assetType} = 'MONEY_BOX' AND money_box_id = #{assetId} ) OR ( #{assetType} = 'ACCOUNT' AND deposit_account_id = #{assetId} ) ) AND auto_transfer_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM (
SELECT at.transfer_amount AS amount FROM goal_asset ga JOIN auto_transfer at ON at.deposit_account_id = ga.asset_id WHERE ga.goal_id = #{goalId} AND ga.asset_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND at.auto_transfer_status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL
SELECT at.transfer_amount AS amount FROM goal_asset ga JOIN auto_transfer at ON at.money_box_id = ga.asset_id WHERE ga.goal_id = #{goalId} AND ga.asset_type = 'MONEY_BOX' AND at.auto_transfer_status = 'ACTIVE' ) temp
